caption: The drawing depicts a rooster-shaped weather vane rendered in shades of muted green, blue, and brown, with darker accents emphasizing the texture and contours of the feathers, comb, and wattle. The rooster stands in profile facing left, with its body positioned upright and its legs fixed to a horizontal and vertical support structure that forms the base. The tail feathers are arched and detailed with curved, layered lines. The comb on the head and the wattle under the beak are distinctly outlined, and the overall background is a plain, light tan or off-white color, with no additional objects or elements present.
title: Weather Vane Finial
